title: Fleet Monitoring With Multi-Resolution Metrics In The Dashboard
description: Complete monitoring of the fleet across all workers: CPU, memory, disk, compilation tasks, graph reads, cache hits (local and remote), remote execution, readiness. Multi-resolution sampling: dense recent samples, progressively squashed older windows (tiered downsampling). Minimal overhead, cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows), zero-touch on every worker, aggregated across the fleet via the shared store, visualized in the repo dashboard TUI. Fully end to end. Related fleet ticket: 26/11/13 FLEET-ONE-MACHINE-SHARED-HOT-CACHE-AND-REMOTE-EXECUTION.
